Convert curves to polylines using angle and distance tolerances.

**Panel:** Comma → Curve · **Nickname:** `Convert`

## Inputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Curve | `C` | Curve | Item |  | Curve to convert |
| Simplify | `S` | Boolean | Item | `false` | Simplify input curve before converting |
| Angle Tolerance | `A` | Number | Item | `5.0` | Maximum angle tolerance |
| Tolerance | `T` | Number | Item | `1.0` | Maximum distance tolerance |
| Min Length | `MinL` | Number | Item | `0.0` | Minimum allowed segment length |
| Max Length | `MaxL` | Number | Item | `0.0` | Maximum allowed segment length |

## Outputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Curve | `C` | Curve | List | Converted curves |
